full_judgment: 21. The learned Advocate for the plaintiff-petitioners next argued that after the auction purchase by the landlord the predecessor of the defendants took settlement of 2.43 acres of land from the auction purchaser landlord. But no kabuliyat or patta has been filed in support of their contention. It is to be stated here that the defendants denied to have taken any settlement of the suit land from the landlord Chandi Charan after alleged auction purchase. Rather their definite case is that they continued in prossession of the suit land from the time of their predecessor-in-interest Nida Gazi in korfa right.
